findings.summary: A quantitative filter with both min=1 and max=1 on the INDEX() table calc did not collapse the BANs to one row on Cloud; the pane repeated the same value once per sub-category.
findings.workaround: Write only the upper bound ({'column': 'Index', 'max': '1'}) exactly as the author's workbook does (<filter ...><max>1</max></filter>).
findings.upstream_note: Range-filter XML is valid; dropping min when min==max would change 'exactly N' to '<= N'.

findings.summary: A customized-label built from a literal '<' run plus a field run plus '> to goal' rendered as '<<field>>' on Cloud because both the literal and the generated field reference are wrapped in angle brackets.
findings.workaround: Drop the literal brackets and rely on the run order: {'field': 'Value to Goal'}, {'text': ' to goal'}.
